synopsis_text: 近未来轨道商业化时代，「环枢七号」研究站因深区一次失败的样品实验与地面失联。 The setting is 环枢七号——浅区气闸室、实验舱群、深区库房的三段线性结构；舷窗外地球始终可见。. 玩家是受雇的回收撤离者，趁 station AI 维护窗口潜入搜刮高价值样件，并在轨道站再入大气层前的撤离窗口离开。 Core loop: 搜刮容器 → 管理负重与噪声 → 击退或避开守卫 → 在气闸开启窗口撤离。. 失败=阵亡于站内或随站体再入焚毁；结局表达见 §10 C02/C03——逃生舱脱离与地球背景为成功意象，警报红光中的失压走廊为失败意象。 Narrative devices: 守卫=站内安保自动化系统在失联后转入的敌对协议；深区危险=样品实验破坏了舱段密封；门禁卡=库房主管的遗留权限。全部原创。. Art direction: 硬科幻工业风；主色=舷窗蓝 #2E5E8C、舱壁灰 #9AA3AB、警示红 #D64541、核心辉金 #FFC46B、深区紫黑 #1B1626；材质为拉丝金属、聚合物面板、结霜管路。. Sound direction: 低鸣空气循环 + 电子提示音；关键声音优先级：撤离倒计时、失压警报、脚步方位必须可辨（见 F07）。. Asset tasks: 10 3d_object, 1 3d_scene, 2 tpose, 7 motion, 15 audio, 4 cg_video; they serve the same declared world, characters and gameplay.
scoring_protocol: 白模主评分配额 S30/M55/L-Regular80/L-Stress105；CH 诊断另列。每行是一个验收终点，binding.subchecks 为必须独立取证的冻结细则，不是额外主项。全部主项及 CH 由同一配置的 VLM 判断；不使用 human.only 或人工回退。子检查角色为 precondition/action/behavior/boundary/recovery。precondition/action 是取证门槛，不计功能完成分。每个子检查只能 PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN；任何必需子检查 UNKNOWN 或取证门槛 FAIL，主项 UNKNOWN。门槛全部通过后，仅按 behavior/boundary/recovery 的 PASS 数/冻结可计分子检查数计算；全通过 PASS、全失败 FAIL，其余 PARTIAL。UNKNOWN/ERROR 不记零分、不缩减冻结分母；仅报告 provisional 和证据覆盖率。补采所缺场景/事件/精确数值或实际模态证据后 VLM 重评；证据仍不足继续 UNKNOWN。代码与声明不能单独证明玩法完成。C2 必须有触发条件、实际操作、结果及拒绝/恢复分支证据。仅在输入已执行且观察窗口完整时才能判失败；环境/评估器故障为 ERROR。C1 故事事实；C2 机制行为；C3 可替换接口；Q 白模构图、比例与占位模型可读性；G 玩家理解与决策；P 首次构建启动稳定性。同一事实只归一个主维度；同源不同事实可分别取证。最终资产导入播放、事件绑定质量留 Track C。先按行等权计算 C1/C2/C3，再 C=mean(C1,C2,C3)，Overall=mean(C,Q,G,P)；CH 不参与。白模允许简图、文字、几何体及占位反馈，不能以缺少最终资产判 FAIL。Q 不评价最终拓扑、材质或精细建模；P 不等于全流程通关，完整游玩闭环还需结合 C2/G 及实际试验覆盖。数值、优先级、例外和实现自由度以 general_requirement.txt 为准，引用上下文不单独计分。

trials.description: Fresh real build; hold on the title for player-facing identity, goal and framing. No gameplay input.

Title → start → exercise the declared core actions (move→WASD; look→鼠标; attack→LMB; interact→R; interact→E; interact→Tab) → observe the running HUD and scene. Waits absorb the declared opening presentation.

Fresh title → start → core actions → pause/continue → then play without optimization or recovery input so the natural outcome path (settlement/loss/recovery) is exercised → restart at the end. Capture continuously at normal speed; no teleport, state injection or simulation-speed change is allowed.

context.F05:
- F05 事件反馈表（冻结需求）：

| 事件 | 画面表现 | 音效 | 结束条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 射击 | 枪口火光+弹壳抛出+准星上跳 | 枪声（射击） | 单发结束 |
| 命中躯干 | hit marker 白 | 命中确认音 | 0.1s |
| 命中头部 | hit marker 金+击杀标记 | 爆头区分音 | 0.15s |
| 开箱搜索 | 进度条+翻找手部动画 | 翻找刮擦声 | 交互完成 |
| 高稀有拾取 | 物品专属闪光（金/紫） | 高稀有专属音 | 0.5s |
| 负重移动 | 镜头摆动加重+HUD 负重档 | 脚步声随负重变重 | 持续 |
| 深区失压 | 红色警示灯+雾气喷溅+屏幕霜边 | 失压警报+泄压嘶声 | 10s 结束 |
| 气闸开启 | 广播灯闪烁 | 广播提示音 | 播报一次 |
| 撤离倒计时最后 10s | 倒计时红字脉动 | 紧迫滴答（每秒） | 撤离或超时 |

  - input：E（触发方：玩家）
  - precondition：贴近容器且未满包
  - state_change：开箱按 G05 序列获得物品、占用背包格；净值更新
  - observable：`open(container, item)` 事件

context.M05:
- M05 负重与噪声（新增）
  - input：移动（触发方：玩家）
  - precondition：处于游玩状态
  - state_change：脚步噪声半径按负重档位 4m（基础档，占用≤4 格）/6m（5–7 格）/8m（8–10 格）；噪声半径内守卫被吸引前往声源调查
  - observable：`noise(level, pos)` 事件与守卫调查行为
  - invalid_case：静止不产生噪声事件
  - recovery：离开声源后守卫 8s 衰减回巡逻

- S07 浅区与实验舱搜刮
  - input：WASD/LMB/R/E/Tab/X（触发方：玩家）
  - precondition：处于轨道站游玩状态
  - state_change：开箱按 §6 M04 结算物品入包；负重与噪声按 M05 更新

  - next_actions：进入深区 →「深区搜刮」；返回撤离区等待 →「撤离阶段」
  - outcome：物品进入背包，超时/死亡不丢弃（V02 例外见后）

LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |
